text.content:
The Queen of the Afterlife.

Role: Fixer (Fixer 10)
Affiliation: Owner of the Afterlife
Where to find them: The back of the Afterlife (#1), Little China
Known for: Decades as one of the best solos for hire; now runs the biggest edgerunner operation in the city, neutral in every war

Rogue has been in the business for decades, first as one of the best solos money could hire and now as the city's most respected fixer. In 2013 she went into Arasaka with Johnny Silverhand and Lyle Thompson after Alt Cunningham.

Plenty of fixers run crews of edgerunners; nobody does it on Rogue's scale. Over the years she has built a personal army of the best of the best, and the Afterlife never takes sides in corporate or gang wars, a testament to her political skill. She'll remember your name if you're worth remembering. Thompson still drinks there, and she still charges him.

Edgerunner's Handbook p.27; Night City 2070 (The Unification Era), ch.02, 04, 08
